import pickle
import redis

r = redis.Redis(host="queue.internal", port=6379)

def run_worker(handlers):
    while True:
        _, raw = r.blpop("jobs:pending")
        job = pickle.loads(raw)
        handler = handlers.get(job["type"])
        if handler is None:
            r.rpush("jobs:dead", raw)
            continue
        handler(job["payload"])

import jsonpickle
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler

class StateHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        state = jsonpickle.decode(self.rfile.read(length).decode())
        self.server.store.restore(state)
        self.send_response(204)
        self.end_headers()

from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs
from urllib.request import urlopen

class PreviewHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        target = parse_qs(urlparse(self.path).query).get("url", [""])[0]
        with urlopen(target, timeout=5) as resp:
            body = resp.read(65536)
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

require "net/http"

server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(Port: 8000)
server.mount_proc "/avatar" do |req, res|
  uri = URI(req.query["image"])
  upstream = Net::HTTP.get_response(uri)
  res.status = upstream.code.to_i
  res["Content-Type"] = upstream["Content-Type"]
  res.body = upstream.body
end
server.start

import hashlib
import sqlite3

def create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, username: str, password: str) -> None:
    digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?)",
        (username, digest),
    )
    conn.commit()
